exposure: Fewer than three antenatal care (ANC) visits
cohort: A randomly sampled group of 400 pregnant women beyond 20 weeks gestation attending antenatal care clinics in rural District Jalaun, Uttar Pradesh, India.
finding: Pre-eclampsia was significantly associated with primigravidity, anemia, obesity, and insufficient antenatal care, and it led to significantly poorer pregnancy outcomes, including increased incidences of low birth weight, IUGR, preterm births, and cesarean sections.
mod_finding: Poorer pregnancy outcomes in the pre-eclamptic group included a significantly higher incidence of cesarean sections.
cross-section timing: When pregnant women were beyond 20 weeks gestation
gest_age: Pregnant women were included if they were beyond 20 weeks gestation.
